---
title: "8. Merry Christmas Bells"
body-classes: lyrics
---

## Verse 1

Oh, the bells are ringing out today  
In a joyous Christmas kind of way.  
They’re ringing, ringing\!  
Ding dong ding dong\!  
Merry Christmas Bells\!  

## Verse 2

Oh, the sound they make is sweet today,  
And I hope that you can hear them play.  
They're ringing, ringing\!  
Ding dong ding dong\!  
Merry Christmas Bells\!  

## Chorus

*They ring, they sing, they jingle*  
*They ding dong ding*  
*They ring, they sing, they jingle, jingle*  
*Ding Dong*  
*Ding Dong*  

## D.C. al Fine

## Coda

They’re ringing, ringing\!  
Ding dong ding dong\!  
Me….rry Christmas Bells…\!  
Ding Dong\!
